target.role: fresh whole-journey belonging and placement discovery for STRANGE GAIT
target.position: Whole journey: before the opener, between every non-protected pair, or after the tail. Preserve only Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer; Truth in Noise → Transparency remains available.
target.purpose: Test current, adjacent/emerging and overlooked material against its strongest plausible lawful placement. Character changes and hard left turns may pass when transition, local-run and long-form intent are supported; selection-lens interest alone is insufficient.

sourceWindows: CURRENT / EMERGING: https://aedirecords.bandcamp.com/album/sisu-2 — all five tracks from Aedi Records' 2026-08-28 community-selected compilation screened; Dvärv — Trama retained as an exact current identity from an anonymous-submission, peer-voted release, without inventing track-specific sonic behaviour.

ADJACENT / EMERGING CATALOGUE: https://ra.co/reviews/35891 — all four Hassan Abou Alam originals and four remixes on 2023's Shalfata screened; Mawgood retained because the exact-track review describes a quavering bassline making a sudden turn into mangled synths and traditional folk drums.

OVERLOOKED TECHNO CATALOGUE: https://evodmusic.bandcamp.com/album/declinations — all four tracks on Evod Music's 2019 Declinations screened; Marcelus — Velvet retained because the official exact-track notes describe a bass sequence and offbeat drum pattern with ethnic percussion interrupted by synthetic incursions.

OVERLOOKED ADJACENT CATALOGUE: https://ra.co/reviews/35749 — all four tracks on DJ JM's 2023 Abnormal EP screened; the title track retained because the exact-track review describes needlepoint hats and snares, apparent speed changes and unusual synth events that remain controlled rather than chaotic.

ADDITIONAL WINDOWS: bounded September 4 and August 28 2026 Bandcamp result windows across Planet Rhythm, Circular Limited, OBSCUUR, Darknet, Major Records and several independent labels were screened. Major Records was not repeated because brenner's release was already mined; recent Delsin, 30D, No.Identity, Mechatronica, Outer Orbit, Soma, Seismic, Sublunar, Sun People, OODA and QEONE lanes were excluded.
explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 37 named tracks across eleven current, adjacent and catalogue release/result windows; metadata and attributed descriptions only, with zero audio auditions.
exclusions: All 14 canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects and every untriggered PARKED revisit were excluded.
The two protected internal handoffs Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer remain unavailable; Truth in Noise → Transparency and every other boundary remain available.
Other tracks from the four selected releases were screened but ranked below the four leads for exact-track evidence or representative value; no artist, label, texture, novelty or role quota was used.

No lead was promoted for recency, artist reputation, genre, title, supplied Spotify identity or assumed BPM. Energy, density, bodily effect, phrase structure, perceived pulse, harmonic relation and mixability remain unknown.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. Marcelus — Velvet: exact-track official notes describe an offbeat drum pattern interacting with bass and percussion, with synthetic interruptions; a strong overlooked structural lead.
2. Hassan Abou Alam — Mawgood: exact-track review describes a sudden structural turn from quavering bassline into mangled synths and traditional folk drums; an adjacent selection-lens lead.
3. DJ JM — Abnormal: exact-track review describes apparent speed changes, sharpened percussion and unusual synth events held under control; a conspicuous-turn catalogue lead.
4. Dvärv — Trama: current 2026 community-selected track from a peer-voted deep/hypnotic techno compilation; exact identity is useful, but track-specific behaviour is unknown.

source: Exact Spotify identity verified from a supplied public track ID or one unambiguous exact Spotify search match; BPM from the declared external source.
